editorial.headline: Air Force Activity: A Closed Category in Indonesia and Bali
editorial.standfirst: This category encompasses the administrative and operational work of the Air Force environment, but it is closed to foreign investment nationally and cannot be registered for PMA in Bali.
editorial.body:
This is not a commercial aviation category. It covers the full range of administrative, operational and related activities within the Air Force environment, including civilian employees working there. The scope expressly excludes Air Force personnel who are seconded elsewhere or hold government positions, such as at Air Force Headquarters.

The registration picture is unusually direct. No business scale is listed as open, and the national PMA status is closed. The foreign-ownership ceiling is 0%, so this is not an activity in which foreign capital can take an ownership stake under the record’s national position. That conclusion follows from the category itself as well as its stated PMA treatment: the work belongs to the institutional environment of the Air Force, rather than to an investor-facing business field.

Bali does not soften that position. The provincial status is also closed, and the record marks the activity as blocked for PMA registration. A foreign investor therefore cannot register this activity in Bali today. The stated Bali reason places it in the medium-high or high-risk range and says that the block does not arise from the island-wide moratorium; the applicable position should nevertheless be verified for the specific address.

That distinction matters. Bali’s permanent PMA moratorium applies to all low- and medium-low-risk KBLI activities, whereas this record identifies a different risk position and a separate closed outcome. The practical reading is not that Bali offers a route around the national restriction, but that the activity remains closed on both levels for reasons recorded independently of the moratorium.
editorial.pullQuote: A foreign investor cannot register this activity in Bali today.
